properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued July 25 at 5:11PM MDT until July 25 at 8:15PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
FFWPUB

The National Weather Service in Pueblo has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
West Central El Paso County in east central Colorado...

* Until 815 PM MDT.

* At 511 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain in Northwest side of Colorado Springs. Between 1 and 1.5
inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 1 to 2.5
inches in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are
possible in the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected
to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Western Colorado Springs.

This includes the following streams and drainages...
Monument Creek, South Douglas Creek including Mountain Shadows,
Holland Park, and east to Monument Creek, Dry Creek including
Peregrine and Rockrimmon subdivisions, West Monument Creek
including extreme southern Air Force Academy, North Douglas Creek
including Oak Valley, and subdivisions to Monument Creek.

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 25 at 4:28PM MDT until July 25 at 6:30PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of west central Colorado, including the
following counties, Mesa and Montrose.

* WHEN...Until 630 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 428 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.3 and 0.8 inches of
rain have fallen.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
mainly rural areas of Southwestern Mesa and Northwestern
Montrose Counties
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

properties.headline: Flood Advisory issued July 25 at 3:41PM MDT until July 25 at 6:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...A portion of northwest Colorado, including the following
counties, Garfield and Rio Blanco.

* WHEN...Until 645 PM MDT.

* IMPACTS...Rises in small streams and normally dry arroyos. Some
low-water crossings may become impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 337 PM MDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 0.7 and 1 inch of rain
has fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.3 to 0.5 inches are expected
over the area. This additional rain will result in minor
flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
mainly rural areas of Southwestern Rio Blanco and Western
Garfield Counties on Missouri and Evacuation Creeks.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
